script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: The line says “Kings crossed it in sorrow,” but the cited passages describe only David crossing in sorrow. Change “Kings” to “David.”

“David crosses in tears” goes beyond the cited passage: 2 Samuel 15:23 says the countryside was weeping. David’s own weeping is mentioned in verse 30. Retitle the moment or extend the passage to include verse 30.
“Shimei’s warning” is about crossing Kidron, but the warning itself does not happen there. The cited passage does not say Shimei actually crossed the valley.
“Pulverized” and “detestable” may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader. Consider “crushed” and “hateful to God,” respectively.
